en.title: Balrogg: Up to 15% Lossless Recompression for Vorbis/Opus Audio
en.hook: Boost audio file size efficiency by up to 15% without quality loss using Balrogg’s lossless Vorbis/Opus recompression.
key_takeaways: Achieve up to 15% size reduction for Vorbis/Opus files without sacrificing audio quality.
Open‑source CLI tool with batch processing support, easy to integrate into pipelines.
Fast, memory‑light C implementation ideal for archival and media workflows.

key_takeaways: 可实现 Vorbis/Opus 音频最大 15% 损失最小化重压缩，保持音质不变。

C 语言实现，速度快，内存占用小，适合归档和媒体处理流程。
